audit.why: Gangplank owns 1-2 on Parrrley/keg poke, 3-5 is a standoff, Yi takes 6 and first item, Gangplank reclaims 2+ items. Matches the packet chart and the mirror, which built its full layer to the same seven rows.
audit.corrected: Framing kept; level 6 now states the actual reason (Highlander slow immunity) instead of a false CC immunity.

audit.why: Spikes are already the right four: level 6 Highlander, first on-hit item, and Gangplank's crit scaling reclaiming the late game.
audit.corrected: Remove Scurvy's 22s/14s cooldown added so the all-in window at first item is countable rather than vague.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[4] claims a 'CC-immune all-in' at 6. Highlander grants immunity to slows only, not to crowd control generally — against a champion with a stun that line would get a player killed. Anti-heal against Remove Scurvy was never mentioned anywhere in the entry despite being the interaction that decides extended trades.
audit.why: Highlander's text is 'immune to all slowing effects'. Gangplank happens to own only slows (Powder Keg, Cannon Barrage), so at 6 you really do ignore his whole peel package — but for the right reason. Remove Scurvy is a 22/20/18/16/14s cleanse-and-heal; Grievous Wounds applied before he eats the citrus is what stops it resetting an extended fight. Nothing in his kit interrupts Meditate, which is worth stating as a positive.
audit.corrected: whys[4] rewritten to slow immunity; Grievous Wounds and the 22s cooldown written into spikes[2], breakdown.cooldowns, dontsFull[1]; report[5] now carries slow immunity, the uninterruptible Meditate and the cleanse cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns named the right two cooldowns but gave neither a number, and framed the window around 'landing a slow that sticks' when Yi's own slow pressure is not the point.
audit.why: The punishable cooldown is Remove Scurvy at 22s rank 1.
audit.corrected: Rewritten around the 22s/14s cleanse window and Grievous Wounds.

edits.before: Track Powder Keg (E) charges and his W, Remove Scurvy — if his barrels are on cooldown and his W slow-cleanse is down, that's your only safe all-in window because you can finally land a slow that sticks.
edits.after: Track Powder Keg charges and Remove Scurvy — 22s at rank 1, 14s maxed. With his barrels spent and that cleanse-heal down, your Grievous Wounds sticks and the all-in has nothing left to undo it.

edits.before: His W (Remove Scurvy) cleanses slows and CC, so don't commit expecting to chase — wait until W is on cooldown before you all-in.
edits.after: Remove Scurvy cleanses slows and heals — 22s at rank 1 — so bring Grievous Wounds and commit while it's down, not while you're chasing.

edits.before: Alpha Strike (Q) goes untargetable to phase through his Powder Keg detonation and Parrrley burst. His W (Remove Scurvy) cleanses your slows, so you can't kite-chase him — wait for it to be down. Meditate (W) out-sustains his single-target Parrrley poke once you have it. Highlander (R) gives the move/attack speed to stick through a barrel chain, and he has no hard CC to peel the dive.
edits.after: Alpha Strike (Q) goes untargetable to phase through his Powder Keg detonation and Parrrley burst. His W (Remove Scurvy) cleanses the slows you land, so wait for its 22s cooldown before chasing. Meditate (W) out-sustains his Parrrley poke and nothing in his kit can interrupt the channel. Highlander (R) makes you immune to keg and Cannon Barrage slows, so he has no peel for the dive.

edits.before: At 6 your CC-immune all-in and Meditate out-duel his no-CC kit.
edits.after: At 6 Highlander's slow immunity ignores his kegs and Cannon Barrage.

edits.before: Your kit is stronger in a straight duel here: he has no hard CC, so if you Alpha Strike onto him and W Meditate through his Parrrley poke, you win the short fight before Cannon Barrage matters.
edits.after: Your kit is stronger in a straight duel here: he has no hard CC, so Meditate cannot be interrupted and Highlander ignores every slow he owns — commit through the poke and win before Cannon Barrage lands.

edits.before: With attack speed online you out-DPS him in melee; the main danger is his self-peel with Remove Scurvy cleansing slows and healing, so burst him fast with true damage.
edits.after: With attack speed online you out-DPS him in melee; his self-peel is Remove Scurvy, a 22s cleanse-and-heal, so open with Grievous Wounds up and true damage through the heal.

notes: Level chart untouched: full phases[].side and content win[] agree row-for-row and match the packet chart, which the mirror's newly created full layer was also built against. The false 'CC-immune' claim at level 6 was the one dangerous line here — Highlander is slow immunity only, and the entry happened to be right about the outcome for the wrong reason.
